source.name: SimBench
source.attribution: SimBench: University of Kassel, TU Dortmund, RWTH Aachen University and Fraunhofer IEE; individual contributors.

assumptions: Balanced three-phase positive-sequence AC power flow (pandapower Newton-Raphson); no unbalance, protection, dynamics or thermal time constants.
Profiles: SimBench 2016 absolute load and PV profiles (15-min), step-wise quasi-static.
Upstream MV grid modelled as SimBench ext_grid at its fixed setpoint; transformer tap position fixed at the SimBench value (no OLTC action).
Loading limits: SimBench max_loading_percent (100 %) on continuous rating; short-term overload capability of transformers is not credited.
PV installed capacity (sn_mva) and PV P profile scaled by 1.5.
MV-side (ext_grid) voltage held at 1.055 pu (explicit fixed upstream boundary assumption, not an observed voltage).
5 SimBench PV-home storages held idle (p=q=0): their converted profiles discharge only and are not energy-consistent.

limits.voltage: per-bus SimBench min_vm_pu/max_vm_pu (LV buses 0.90-1.10 pu = EN 50160 +/-10 %; MV buses 0.965-1.055 pu); fallback 0.90-1.10 pu
limits.violation_rule: strict: vm > max, vm < min, loading > max_loading_percent

convergence.energy_scope: only converged PF steps with stable controls

payload.title: LV rural1 (scenario 2) - PV x1.5, MV 1.055 pu
